_🔒 Security & Privacy_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Set `persist-credentials: false` on both checkouts.**

If a run checks out repository content supplied by a party, its tests or scripts can read the persisted token from `.git/config`. The workflow only needs explicit GitHub API credentials for downloads. No step needs persisted Git credentials.

Apply the same change to the `native-package` checkout.

_🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Make both `finally` cleanup operations non-fatal.**

`$work` is reused by `EnsureWindowsRuntime`, `release-verify`, and `desktop-bootstrap`. With `$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'`, a `Remove-Item` failure in `finally` can replace the installation error and, when `$LogPath` is set, prevent `Stop-Transcript` from running. A `Stop-Transcript` failure can also replace the earlier error.

```diff
-}finally{Remove-Item -LiteralPath $work -Recurse -Force;if($LogPath){Stop-Transcript|Out-Null}}
+}finally{Remove-Item -LiteralPath $work -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;if($LogPath){Stop-Transcript -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Out-Null}}
```
